name: Konter a Matt
summary: Luxembourgish 4-player partnership trick-taking game with permanent Queens as top trumps
rules_text: Four players form two fixed teams sitting opposite, using a 24-card deck A K Q J 10 9. Card points: A=4 K=3 Q=2 J=1. Three Queens are permanent trumps ranking after trump Ace: SQ, HQ, DQ (Matt and two Konters). Forehand examines 3 cards and declares trump suit, then each player gets 6 cards. Before first trick, a player holding SQ may announce Matt, holding HQ+DQ may announce Konter, holding both may announce Konter a Matt, doubling or tripling game value. Must follow suit if able but may trump instead; if trump led must trump if possible. Highest trump wins, otherwise highest of led suit. 6 tricks are played. Team scoring over 20 points wins the hand (40 total); 20-20 is a draw. Match is played for lines: winners erase lines equal to game value, losers who declared add lines.
rating_reason: Four-player trick-taking Couillon family, clear partnership strategy
